methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: This study developed a new approach to assess the energy performance of compressed air systems based on a six-step local energy benchmarking methodology. The methodology includes an energy management procedure to monitor and control the electricity consumption and sustain the energy performance of compressed air systems in time. The procedure monitors the production and use of compressed at plant and at manufacturing section levels based on the real-time monitoring of relevant variables to calculate energy performance indicators, energy baselines, and CUSUM charts.

evidence_quote: Given the variety of products manufactured in some plants, the concept of equivalent production outlined by ISO 50006 [50], might be indicated.
The ISO 50000 standard proposes guidance for the development and implementation of an energy management system based on tools like the energy benchmarking, the EnB, the EnPIs, etc. [27,33].
The daily use of CA was correlated to the equivalent battery production.

The CUSUM is used as a control tool at both levels. It is used for monitoring the deviation of the real-time consumption of CA or electricity as compared to the consumption forecasted by the EnB, thus alerting the occurrence of inefficiencies.
